visualCharacteristics.structure: 2-col text inputs + select + textarea + consent checkbox + pill submit

contentPattern: Inline field rows (layout only, no submission backend yet). Row per field, cells: [Label] | [Type: text|email|tel|select|textarea|checkbox|submit] | [Name] | [Required: yes/no] | [Options or placeholder: for select, one option per line/paragraph with the default first; for checkbox, rich text label with links]. Fields from source: name (text, req), organization (text, req), email (email, req), number (tel, req), subject (select, req, 8 options, default "Product | Quality"), query (textarea, req), agree (checkbox, req, label links Privacy Statement + Terms of Use PDF), Submit. Optional row "Action" | <url> configures a submit endpoint later; optional row "Message" | <text> overrides the inline message. When no Action row is authored, submit performs client-side required/format validation then shows a neutral inline message (no network request). Never send data anywhere unless an Action row is authored.
